problem: UADOS task leases are local workflow records, but there is no explicit pluggable lease/fencing contract or measured SQLite history baseline for future multi-host coordination.
background: Phase 3 trust, recursive evidence manifests and fake-only dispatch receipts are complete. The existing SQLite/event authority and task lease behavior are stable and must remain additive.
alternatives: Keep cooperative local task leases with no coordination boundary
Add a remote coordination service before defining semantics
Modify the SQLite authority and task schema directly
Add an injectable fenced-lease state machine and read-only history benchmark
decision: Add an explicit reference lease backend with monotonic fencing and injected-clock expiry, plus a read-only SQLite history benchmark; defer durable remote coordination and schema changes.
impact: Future adapters can implement the same acquire/renew/release/validate contract, while operators get a reproducible local history baseline without changing current task or ledger behavior.
risk: The reference backend is process-local and cannot prove cross-host safety, authenticated identity, durable fencing, clock synchronization, partition behavior or remote availability.
validation: Focused state-machine and benchmark no-mutation tests, full regression, scaffold and final audit with explicit local-only limits.
